criteria.description: AI/ML legacy command/result constants retain the phase-1 38390-38399 namespace and avoid NIP-90 reserved 5000-7000 ranges, while production signer-first publishing uses canonical ContextVM events instead of reviving those legacy kinds.
AI/ML legacy read-model constants retain 31980-31989 for migration inventory, while production read-model observation uses canonical addressable state with stable d-tag coordinates and EOSE catch-up.

Every long-running import, recipe, deployment, and rollback flow returns Nostr correlation metadata and observes progress/completion through ContextVM result/read-model events rather than HTTP polling or sleep-based completion.

Injected AI/ML command/result handling includes required e/p/status/correlation tags and relevant scoped tags when present, including model, version, recipe, run, endpoint, environment, deployment, artifact, worker, task, accelerator, and runtime; executable missing-d validation is proven for the retained model-import direct handler only.
Existing LLM 597x/697x/797x/3196x compatibility semantics remain stable and are not mutated into generic AI semantics.

coverage_notes: Executable verification was added by bahia-vn8o on 2026-06-07.

Repository policy currently treats the 38390-38399 and 31980-31989 custom ranges as legacy/migration inventory only; production runtime evidence therefore proves canonical ContextVM 25910 plus canonical observable state instead of reviving legacy runtime publication.
